sentences.text: Volgadraco, meaning "Volga River dragon", is a genus of pterosaur from the Upper Cretaceous of European Russia.
The species was described in 2008 by Averianov, Arkhangelsky, and Pervushov.
Its type species is V. bogolubovi, with the specific name honoring Russian paleontologist Nikolai Nikolaevich Bogolubov.
In 2020, Averianov and Arkhangelsky classified Volgadraco as a member of the family Pteranodontidae.
However, the Spanish taxobox lists Volgadraco as belonging to the family Azhdarchidae.
Volgadraco lived from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
It inhabited a time between older Santonian or Turonian azhdarchids and later Maastrichtian azhdarchids.
In 2026, Averianov and Arkhangelsky debated the validity of the genus, suggesting its fossils might belong to different types of pterosaurs.
